create_confdict_with_dot_keys: create a ConfDict from nested dicts using dot-notation keys like y.thing and y.stuff
flatten_confdict_to_dot_notation: call flat on a ConfDict to get a flattened dictionary with dot-separated keys
generate_uid_from_confdict: generate a unique string identifier from a ConfDict using to_uid with an optional version parameter
update_confdict_with_override: update a ConfDict using the OVERRIDE flag to replace nested keys instead of merging them
parse_cli_args_to_confdict: parse command-line arguments like --optim.lr=0.01 into a ConfDict using from_args
